pronunciation.approximation: Say "urcaguary" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Urcaguary".

domains.title: Urcaguary
domains.subtitle: Underworld Jewels
domains.lead: Urcaguary is underworld jewels. The name means "He of the underground" and belongs to the incan tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Urcaguary place underworld jewels at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Urcaguary appears in incan tradition as underworld jewels. The name's meaning, "He of the underground", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Urcaguary in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Urcaguary remains a touchstone for understanding incan religion, art, and identity.
scholarlySources: Bauer, Brian S., The Sacred Landscape of the Inca (1998).
